text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated KV cache allocations detected on prod-cluster-c (region-us-west2). paging_rate spiked, swap used. suspected quant-path regression (int8/awq/gptq). trace_id=tr-9Kp2\n\noncall-nyc: taking this P1. I'm seeing timeouts on long-chat flows hitting /v1/chat.complete. Any recent runtime changes?

jamie: I merged kernel-select v3 at 02:17 UTC earlier today which added gptq fallback and AWQ preference for int8. Canary perf looked fine but canary traffic had shorter contexts. Prod long-chat traffic seems to trigger much larger kv entries with the new path.

lee: metric snapshot: model \"orion-long-awq-int8\" per-pod kv_cache_bytes 720MB -> 1.12GB within 90s. continuous_batch_active_requests doubled. Noticing a pattern: requests with >6k tokens show kv_element_size ~2.6x baseline when AWQ/gptq path selected.

maria: support: multiple customer reports of slow responses and 502s for extended sessions. Tickets #8019, #8020. Notifying customer success and account owners.

eng-runtime: confirming AWQ/gptq backend does increase KV footprint for certain attention layers due to wider encoded keys. We didn't include a conservative guard for long-context models.

oncall-nyc: immediate mitigation options? 1) force legacy selector for affected model group, 2) throttle continuous batching concurrency, 3) ramp up eviction aggressiveness. We should pick the least user-visible that restores stability quickly.

jamie: fastest tested in staging: override kernel selector back to legacy for affected models. Example override used in staging:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://infra-api.internal/v1/runtime/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"orion-long-awq-int8","kernel_selector":"legacy-int8"}'
```
Staging reverted kv sizes to baseline in ~25s.

lee: rolling that override to prod hot pools now (pool=kv-hotpool-c). Rolling update with maxUnavailable=1.

ops-bot: deploy-started: override/legacy-selector-rollback to prod-cluster-c by lee (change_id=chg-104556)

jamie: after rollback on one hotpod, kv_cache_bytes fell from 1.1GB -> 750MB, p95 latency improved. We'll watch for any regressions in model quality but customers prioritized stability.

eng-runtime: adding short-term runtime circuit: if request.predicted_kv_growth > 1.2 then prefer legacy kernels for int8/awq/gptq until we have packing improvements. Also instrumenting per-request kv size telemetry (histograms + quant_path label).

sre-rotation: adding temporary auto-throttle rule: when host_kv_bytes / host_mem > 0.68 then reduce continuous_batch_concurrency by 50% and send high-priority pager. Creating infra ticket infra-1333 to track.

dev-qa: pushing a synthetic long-context canary that sends 10k-token requests across quant paths to measure kv allocations. Will run every deploy for the next week.

oncall-nyc: monitoring: eviction_rate and paging_rate trending down after rollback. Customers reporting improved latency. Declaring incident mitigated but keeping channel open for follow-ups.

ops-bot: deploy-complete: override/legacy-selector-rollback to prod-cluster-c by lee (change_id=chg-104556)

jamie: follow-ups assigned: jamie -> RCA + PR for selector guard and unit tests; sasha -> selector policy refactor + integration tests; lee -> rollout automation for quick overrides; dev-qa -> long-context canary and regression harness.

maria: customer comms: sent status update to affected accounts with ETA for RCA. No data exposure.

sre-rotation: runbook update proposal: add a gating check in CI that runs a kv-element-size diff for canaries; if growth >20% fail the rollout. Filing infra-1334.

eng-runtime: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4945 - adds predicted_kv_growth guard, telemetry labels, and unit tests.

oncall-nyc: assigning postmortem owner: jamie. Severity set to S2 (mitigated). Keep monitoring for 2h post-mitigation and then schedule the postmortem.

ops-bot: incident-note: timeline recorded (incident=inc-2028-01-kv-quant, start=2028012345, mitigated=2028015678)

lee: final check: p95 latency back to baseline, continuous_batch queue drained, no further paging alerts. Closing active mitigation window.

maria: will draft RCA and customer-facing summary tomorrow; linking infra tickets infra-1333, infra-1334 and runtime PR.

oncall-nyc: thanks everyone. Closing live incident but leaving thread for postmortem discussion. :white_check_mark:
